Watch 4 Ads or Pay $10.99 a Month. I downloaded Mystic Mondays about two years ago around the time I first started college to check it out with a friend who also shared the same interest in tarot, but unfortunately we didn’t have the time to put more effort into learning the cards at the time. I want to start out by saying that I have loved this app and it’s interface, you can tell a lot of work has been put into it by the developers and I have even considered buying their physical deck at one point, however, with this new update I can’t say that I’m as satisfied as I once was. I have loved the addition of the daily crystal, zodiac, and animal cards and didn’t mind when a few of the more of the in depth features went behind a paywall, but with this latest update, you now have to watch an ad before drawing each of your daily cards, pay $1 for a single day of “fast pass”, or pay 10.99 a month to unlock everything. That means now you would have to watch 4 second ads for your 4 daily cards. I am all for supporting developers, but it’s extremely redundant and unwelcoming, almost unmotivating as well, to have an ad before every single card. I would like to see you guys change this in the future to maybe an ad to unlock them all for the day, I think this would open up more willing support from the community without creating an unfriendly user experience.

For people angry about the ads it seems people expect a ton of beautiful aesthetics, information, & effort from an app & don’t consider there are real people running it. If you want content, someone has to develop it. If you want FREE content, SOMEONE HAS TO DEVELOP IT. Why do people expect those who offer spiritual services to offer their work for free? Real human beings have real lives & real bills to pay would you offer your services at your job for no pay? If you can’t afford a monthly subscription, that’s fine (I can’t afford the premium services from the app right now either). The **very short skippable after a few seconds** ads are a way to keep the app available & people who develop the app & content sustained. I highly doubt anyone on the MM team is diving into a pool of gold coins because of a $9.99 monthly fee. You want something? Too Stylized and Doesn’t Resonate. The deck is beautifully designed. I can tell a lot of thought and love went into each card.

Why am I giving one star?
I downloaded the application to learn more about the Tarot deck and get a daily card pull. 

Maybe it’s because a computer is spitting out a card and a meaning behind the card which is why it just doesn’t resonate with me. But even when I approach the card from a learning perspective, I can’t see how that interpretation of the card matches with the artwork. It literally makes no sense. 

With the traditional Rider-Smith-Waite deck, you can discern the meaning of the card from the intricately designed pictures. With this deck, it’s so overly simplified that the deck itself is almost glossing over the deeper meaning of each card and only giving you the highlights. The written meanings of the card don’t really match with what I would intuitively get from the card either.

If you like pretty things, and you like a computer giving you a different card each day. Then enjoy the application. If you need a human giving you a reading don’t download the application.

I also greatly enjoy the addition of the point system, as it helps make it feel more accessible and welcoming. Plus it’s a great incentive to stay on track! The overall design and branding is engaging and beautiful, and it is fun to explore the different sections. Great job!!

Some feedback:

⤵️ on the daily cards, it would be nicer to leave the description expanded, with the option to “… read less” instead of automatically keeping it hidden. I always read the full descriptions, and they don’t seem long enough to warrant having the collapsed version be the norm. 

🔡 the formatting on the crystal card description is a little wonky, it seems like there are unintentional paragraph breaks midway through sentences, which leave odd gaps that decreases the readability. The formatting for the tarot and cosmic creature cards is correct, so I would recommend adjusting the crystal card to match them. 

📶 in the Insights section, you are able to swipe to scroll across the different insight categories (Tarot, Chakra, Elements, etc). You are also able to swipe through the sub categories of each main one (ex: under Tarot there is the Major Arcana, Cups, Swords, Pentacles, and Wands). The issue I’ve noticed is that it is difficult to swipe one or the other intentionally, as when you try to swipe the subcategories, it will frequently scroll through the main categories. I would like the option to select one of the main categories, and have it open onto a full page view so that it is easier to navigate through the specific category and its subcategories (like the For You section) without worrying that I might accidentally swipe away. Reformatting it to be more like the For You section would also help the Insights section feel a bit less cramped, as I feel that the current setup is doing the infographics and layout a disservice. 

I hope you find this feedback helpful, and I appreciate all the hard work you put into creating this app! Thank you again 💖
